observations: The Viewer is operational and camera movement changes the rendered viewpoint.
The 7k model is dominated by large blurred/fog-like regions and unstable floating texture.
Only the back direction is partly recognizable as an indoor scene; the other horizontal directions are not consistently interpretable.
The up and down captures do not preserve clearly identifiable ceiling and floor structure.
Because stable geometry and occlusion relationships are not visually reliable, this is not accepted as a walkable indoor reconstruction.

walkthrough.sequence: zoom -> normal walk -> 3x sprint -> look up/down -> walk

reason30kBlocked: The v10 contract forbids a 30k continuation when the 7k user-facing visual gate fails.
